title: Patty & Theo:
headline: For five months the doctors called Theo's pain a growing pain. His mom kept working, kept driving, and Family Reach made her life easier.
story: Theo was a sporty kid: swimming, golf, baseball, soccer. Doctors said his pain was “a growing pain” for five months. Then the diagnosis. Patty works to care for him and drives to Boston every day. Family Reach did the research and handed her the help, so she could just take care of her kid.
End on Patty's “full circle”: the family that always gave is now on the receiving end. Warm and hopeful. A shorter cut of your approved long-form V7.
